input_contract.entries: nonempty list of row, col, value; upper-triangular coordinates are admitted
input_contract.value: canonical rational with reduced decimal-string num and positive decimal-string den

output_contract.definiteness: classification consistent with the three inertia counts

mathematical_scope: One exact corroborating column-update example only; not evidence for the universal theorem.
example: Start with M_ij=1/(h(x_i,x_j)+1/2) at x=(0,1/2,-1/2), then add (1/10) M_i0 M_0j. The payload is the entrywise reciprocal of the updated matrix.
